hero.title: Welcome home, where faith and family grow together.
hero.text: A church in the heart of the city, with the city in its heart. Join us as we worship Jesus, grow through His Word, and serve our community.

online.title: Worship with us anywhere.
online.text: Stream services from home or on the go and stay connected to the House of Bread family.

welcome.title: A church family where faith can flourish.
welcome.text1: House of Bread Ministries is dedicated to nurturing both the spirit and the community. We gather to worship, learn Scripture, experience God’s love, and serve together.
welcome.text2: People of all ages and backgrounds are welcome as we pursue renewed hearts, transformed lives, and deeper faith in Jesus Christ.

nextStep.title: Take your next step.
nextStep.text: Explore studies, prayer, youth ministry, events, and opportunities to serve and be spiritually nourished.
